definition: A person or thing regarded as an outstanding example.
author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quote: It appeared to be desirable to recall his memory, because I have discerned in him such indications of valour and fortune as should make him a great exemplar to men.
example_sentence: Her essay was used as an exemplar for the whole class.
